rationale: The original short thesis predicated on rejection below the $124.37 session VWAP has failed, as buyers stepped in at the $124.10 double-bottom and drove price back up to $124.90 through consecutive higher highs on the 1-minute bars. With the stock now firmly reclaiming VWAP and pushing toward the top of its daily range (78.4%), cutting the position early preserves capital rather than waiting for a likely test of the $125.40 invalidation level.
